key_insight: Mamba-QE replaces the Transformer in a generative quantum eigensolver with a selective state space model, reducing operator-sequence processing complexity from quadratic to linear in sequence length.
engineering_relevance: Linear sequence processing offers a route toward more scalable molecular ground-state simulations, though larger-system performance remains unproven.
method: Frame ground-state search as discrete quantum-operator sequence generation.
Use a Mamba selective state space backbone with O(L) sequence-processing complexity.
Condition generation on molecular distance to predict potential energy surfaces.
evidence_signal: On H₂ across 16 geometries, the abstract reports energy errors below 3×10⁻⁶ Ha relative to Full Configuration Interaction, with zero variational violations.
watch_item: Evaluation is limited to H₂; linear backbone complexity does not establish end-to-end scaling or accuracy for larger molecules.
paper_title: Mamba Quantum Eigensolver (MQE): A Selective State Space Model for Scalable Ground State Simulations in Quantum Chemistry
